## Funktionen approximieren

### Funktionen

```{julia}
x = parameter(0 .. 4π)
f = cos(x)
g = 1 - x / (4π)
h = f * g

fplot(f, g, h)
```

## Zur Interpretation von loglog-Plots

```{julia}
mks = monomials(1:4, 0.0001 .. 1)
fplot(mks...)
```

```{julia}
f = Figure()
Axis(f[1, 1], xscale=log10, yscale=log10)
fplot!(mks...)
f
```
